temporary_environment.creation_method: python -m venv; python -m pip install -r requirements-lock.txt

workload: 1024 fixed synthetic 64x64 RGB images with foreground and background; batch size 128; verified Exp002 autoencoder, optimizer, FP32 precision rules, and balanced reconstruction loss; two complete training epochs per repetition
timing_boundary: time.perf_counter from immediately before the first DataLoader iteration through completion of two training epochs; model/optimizer construction excluded; DataLoader construction excluded; DataLoader startup and iteration included
warmup_policy: one identical full workload execution per candidate, excluded from measured timings
process_lifecycle_policy: one fresh process per candidate; OMP_NUM_THREADS and MKL_NUM_THREADS set before native scientific imports
repetition_policy: three measured repetitions per completed candidate
candidate_generation_policy: staged compute-thread search using visible CPU capacity, followed by inter-op and OMP/MKL interaction checks; wall-clock only
environment_restriction: DataLoader multiprocessing requires IPC/socket resources prohibited by the execution environment; num_workers > 0 is ENVIRONMENT_INFEASIBLE
